0022600099.text: The Chicago Bulls (0-1, 5th in the Central and 15th in the East) visit the Milwaukee Bucks (0-1, 4th in the Central and 13th in the East), with both teams one game back in their divisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season series the Bulls lost 1-3, though Chicago won their most recent meeting 120-97 in Chicago on March 1, 2026. Nic Claxton is out for Chicago with a hamstring injury, and Dailyn Swain (illness), Jordan Hawkins (illness), Josh Giddey (wrist), Tobe Awaka (knee sprain), and Zach Collins (quadriceps) are all day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions.
